name: valve_citadel_walkway_reactor
note: HL2 Citadel stasis reactor (d3_citadel_03, the first stasis room; d3_citadel_04 has the same column with two thin zapper columns beside it): a round walkway of Combine glass (inner edge about 177 from the centre, outer rim about 330, 15 railing_128 props on the rim with gaps) round an open hole about 150 across the radius, edged by a metal lip; over the hole, 896 up, a round cap. In the hole a column of light: three env_citadel_energy_core (floor, middle, top), two env_beam between info_targets, a stasisvortex prop at the top, stasisfield and stasisshield props, two lights. Step in and you float: trigger_vphysics_motion, 304 square, floor to cap, gravity 0, speed held to 100, a blue particle trail on whoever enters; the middle 80 square is a trigger_physics_trap that dissolves anything but a combine ball. Filter filter_combine_ball (negated: everything but balls passes). Always on, nothing fires into it. Wiring in 'wiring' (read prefabs.md, 'Pieces with their wiring'). Anchor: the hole's centre on the walkway floor; faces all ways. The tool dropped the NPC clip (304 square, 128 tall) that keeps NPCs out of the hole: add it back.
